title: forge explain data
description: Payload of `forge explain --json`: one diagnostic code, or every registered code with `--list`. An unknown code is an error envelope with empty data and `error.suggestion` pointing at `--list`.

code.description: The code that was asked for, e.g. `E030`.

explain.description: Full explanation, with a `Wrong:` and a `Right:` snippet.

codes.description: Every registered code, in registry order.
